spiritgiven.comments: Generally a great spirited game with some isolated examples. Hand signals could be used more in the game during calls. There was one player who was quick to say “nonono” when a call was made, but her teammate corrected her :)
There was great communication both within their team and with our team throughout the game. We appreciate the patient and early feedback from their spirit captains :)

There were multiple incidents where body contact was more than appreciated, but GB was really open to feedback throughout the game. 

We appreciate the fair mindedness of the whole team, making the right calls even when it was disadvantageous to them. :) <3

There were multiple instances of fouls and body contact that was not appreciated by our team, and can be worked on for future games.

There was early and constant communication between our spirit captains, which was greatly appreciated :)

There were a few instances where body language was not ideal during calls, and some calls took longer to resolve. However, we appreciate that their teammates helped to call out these instances  to correct each other :)

There were multiple instances of fouls and body contact, especially when they were cutting (pushing our players to make the cuts). Feedback was given and some improvements were made but the fouls and body contact were still more than we appreciated.

There were instances where we felt they could have communicated with their teammates more positively.

A few players did not seem open to our perspectives and insisted on their perspectives. Hopefully that will be worked on for future games :)

There was a little too much contact on the mark for our liking. Spatial awareness can also be improved on for future games (to look out for both our players and their own teammates) to avoid reckless plays.

Kudos to CT for working on the other feedback from the previous games :)

As we mentioned in the spirit circle, we were happy with the contact during half time. However, we felt that fouls and body contact picked up in the second half, and was more than we appreciated.

We appreciated the positivity and energy on the sidelines! Thank you for the game :)

There were multiple instances of mocking on the sidelines (mainly by their coach) when calls were made and instances of eye-rolling.

There were also multiple instances where our players felt their team was not open to our perspectives. 

It was overall an intense game, and their high spirits on the sidelines was commendable :)

spiritreceived.comments: Thank you for taking our feedback and implementing it! Also loved the positive attitude!

Congratulations Singapore ! 
We loved your positive attitude all along the game, no matter the score. As we mentioned, we thought there is a bit of work to do on avoiding travels (without talking about the accepted travels form the new rules). 
Great great game, thank you again ! 
Xoxox
France.

Angel was great at communicating effectively and quickly when a spirit issue occurred. They also kept positive attitudes through all the game which was also appreciated.Thank u guys for bring this spirited game!:)
